title: Desk surface protocol v0: a native plugin's page messages
description: What a native plugin's surface and the desk say to each other besides the surface itself: the messages a web plugin's page and the desk post to each other (desk:hello, desk:init, desk:ping and desk:pong, desk:state, ...), carried on the surface's connection because a native plugin has no page. See native.md.

SurfacePageMessage.description: A page message as the plugin SDK and the desk's runtime post it: an object with a desk: type. The desk reads only its type; the rest is the message's own.

SurfaceDeskMessage.description: The desk posts message to the plugin, as it posts to a web plugin's frame: desk:init after the plugin's desk:hello, desk:ping, desk:theme, desk:command, desk:event.

SurfacePluginMessage.description: The plugin posts message to the desk, as a web plugin's page posts to its parent: desk:hello once it listens, desk:ready once it is up, desk:pong for each desk:ping, desk:state to keep its state.
